# LumiRPEngine reference

<!-- Generated by `bun run reference` (scripts/reference/build.ts). Edit the packs, then run it again. -->

What the engine and its packs register, as the registry has it: kinds and their fields, effects and the arguments they read, formula functions, actions, events, proposal channels, panels, slots, data tables and lint codes. Arguments and parameters marked `?` may be left out. The formula language is in [EXPRESSIONS.md](EXPRESSIONS.md), worked examples are in [RECIPES.md](RECIPES.md), and the [user guide](USER-GUIDE.md#authoring) shows the editors.

Engine `0.1.0` · world format `lre-world-v1` · packs `engine` 1, `calendar` 1, `space` 1, `economy` 1, `gear` 1, `vehicles` 1, `weather` 1, `relationships` 1, `castlife` 1, `sheets` 1, `story` 1, `combat` 1, `minds` 1.

| `link` | `rel`, `from`, `to`, `until?`, `fields?` |
| `move` | `entity`, `to` |
| `note` | `text`, `visibility?` |
| `post` | `lines`, `memo?` |
| `recover` | `entity`, `field`, `amount?`, `full?` |
| `set` | `entity`, `field`, `value` |
| `signal` | `class`, `text`, `entity?`, `visibility?` |
| `spawn` | `kind`, `name`, `id?`, `tier?`, `fields?`, `relations?`, `agent?`, `place?`, `class?`, `tags?` |
| `stage` | `track`, `to` |
| `unlink` | `rel`, `from`, `to` |

### Formula functions

Math: `abs`, `ceil`, `clamp`, `floor`, `max`, `min`, `round`. `min` and `max` take any number of arguments.

The engine's own:

- `at(entity, place)`
- `attempts(track)`
- `band(entity, field)`
- `count_at(place, kind?)`
- `days(n)`
- `field(entity, field)`
- `fired(rule)`
- `has_rel(entity, type, to?)`
- `holiday()`
- `hours(n)`
- `knows(entity, subject)`
- `level(entity, domain)`
- `next_time(time)`
- `place(entity)`
- `rel(entity, type, to?)`
- `rel_count(entity, type)`
- `rel_field(from, type, to, field)`
- `revealed(track, stage?)`
- `roll(notation)`: effect arguments only
- `since(track)`
- `stage(track)`
- `table(table, key, column)`
- `table_step(table, value, column)`
- `today_at(time)`

Taxonomy and life states:

- `band_of(entity)`
- `has_tag(entity, tag)`
- `in_class(entity, facet, value)`
- `kind_is(entity, kind)`
- `life_of(entity)`
- `member_of(entity, group)`
- `tier_of(entity)`

### Events

Core: `add`, `clock`, `link`, `materialize`, `post`, `set`, `spawn`, `stage`, `timelapse`, `unlink`.

Engine bookkeeping: `engine.adjudged`, `engine.attempt`, `engine.beat`, `engine.caught`, `engine.check`, `engine.choice`, `engine.class`, `engine.cursor`, `engine.entity`, `engine.fired`, `engine.life`, `engine.note`, `engine.observed`, `engine.pause`, `engine.revealed`, `engine.signal`, `engine.told`.

### Relation types

Built in: `in`, `owns`, `uses`, `worn_by`, `equipped`, `knows`, `member_of`, `regard`, `route`. Packs add the typed ones below.

|---|---|
| `knows` | `knows` |
| `life` | `life` |
| `spawn` | `spawn` |

Signals: `agents_present`, `always`, `beat`, `classifier`, `conflict`, `day_start`, `invitation`, `never`, `offscreen`, `present`, `reply`, `scene_change`, `slot_crossed`, `tie_zone`, `timelapse`, `typed_input`, and `every_n:<k>`.

Template placeholders: `beats`, `brief`, `character`, `clock`, `facts`, `outcome`, `place`, `pov`, `present`, `recent`, `reply`, `scene`, `user`, `world`.

### Sections

The slots a world gets when it defines none, kept in rank order on the section budget.

| Slot | Label | Rank |
|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | Outcome | 0 |
| `montage` | Montage | 1 |
| `scene` | Scene | 2 |
| `people` | People | 3 |
| `money` | Money | 4 |
| `gear` | Gear | 5 |
| `vehicles` | Vehicles | 6 |
| `quest` | Quest | 7 |
| `outline` | Outline | 8 |
| `stance` | Stance | 9 |
| `minds` | Minds | 10 |

### Realism

Domains: `money`, `gear`, `vehicles`, `castlife`, `relationships`, `space`, `calendar`, `weather`, `sheets`; each at a level from 0 to 4.

Detail bands: `principal` (Leads), `supporting` (Supporting), `background` (Background).

Interrupt classes: `invitation`, `bill`, `decline`, `incident`, `quest`, `rule`, `arrival`, `overdue`, `needs`, `weather`.

### Adjudication presets

| Value | `narrative` | `balanced` | `crunchy` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checks` | `"risky"` | `"every"` | `"every"` |
| `riskyAt` | `0.75` | `0.75` | `0.75` |
| `trivialAt` | `null` | `0.95` | `null` |
| `impossibleAt` | `null` | `0.05` | `null` |
| `description` | `{"weight":"none","max":3,"advantageAt":2}` | `{"weight":"bonus","max":2,"advantageAt":2}` | `{"weight":"none","max":2,"advantageAt":2}` |
| `authority` | `"narrative"` | `"hybrid"` | `"mechanics"` |
| `closeBy` | `2` | `2` | `2` |
| `retry` | `"changed"` | `"changed"` | `"free"` |
| `retryAfter` | `60` | `60` | `60` |
